**Three judgment calls worth your eye**

1. **The type had to go in `domain`, not the service file.** A repo interface whose methods mention a `service`-local struct can never be satisfied — `repository` importing `service` is an import cycle, and an unexported type is unreachable anyway. So the interface speaks `*domain.GiftCard`, matching the layer chain (`domain→repo→service`). The interface itself stays unexported and local to the service, which is the house pattern (`attendancePhotoWriter`, `facePolicyReader`).

2. **Error strings are Indonesian.** `p-backend.md:71` says a `service/` error forwarded as `writeError(…, err.Error(), …)` is merchant-facing copy and must be Indonesian per `p-copy-style.md`. These four rejections are exactly that — a cashier sees them at the terminal — so: `saldo kartu hadiah tidak cukup`, `kartu hadiah sudah kedaluwarsa` (repo's spelling, not "kadaluarsa"), `kode kartu hadiah tidak dikenali`, `kartu hadiah sudah tidak aktif`. Formal, no em dash. If your coming handler instead maps them to codes and writes its own copy, these can switch to English — but then the handler owns the strings.

3. **The balance check is in two places on purpose.** The in-service `card.Balance < amount` exists to produce the right *message*; the thing that actually protects the balance is a guard inside `repo.Debit`'s `UPDATE … WHERE balance >= amount AND is_active`, returning `ok=false` when it refuses. Also refused: `amount <= 0`, blank code, and anything over `domain.MaxBillAmount` (via `ValidateBillAmount`). A refusal never calls `Debit` — asserted in every case.

**There is also no "live" to hook into.** The BE has no WebSocket; the only `text/event-stream` is the AI chat reply. The FE is `adapter-static` with `prerender = true` — pure static output to Plesk, no Node runtime. The closest real number, `BulanCrmBE.new_customers`, is *first-time buyers* derived from `first_order` dates, at monthly granularity — a buyer, not a prospect, and with no "just arrived" moment to react to.

So building this would have meant inventing both the metric and the event, on the CEO's screen. That is the one thing this repo's product rules forbid most explicitly ("lubang data ditandai, tidak dikarang"), and the CEO is precisely the reader who cannot distinguish an invented number from a company number.

I also deliberately did **not** bolt polling onto the CEO page. Nothing live would be shown, and commit `545ad8e` just finished stopping request storms on every page — adding an unrequested `setInterval` would reintroduce that exact class.

## What I delivered

`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-08-scoreboard-leads-live-design.md`, following the repo's existing spec convention and language. It records the verification evidence, then specifies what has to land before this is buildable:

1. A **leads table** (new migration — note AGENTS.md already says even *order count* exists in no table; leads are further out still).
2. An agreed **definition of "lead"** — Brighty/Ciara/Jiera sell on Shopee/TikTok/Meta, and marketplaces don't hand over pre-purchase prospects. Incoming chats? WA/form signups? Attributed ad clicks? Without this the scoreboard has no meaning even once a table exists. **This one is yours to answer, not mine.**
3. `GET /api/v1/leads/scoreboard` carrying the standard provenance envelope.

Plus the FE design: `src/lib/adapter/leads.ts`, `src/lib/ui/PapanLeads.svelte`, reusing the existing `LiveBelumTersambung.svelte`, with `types.ts` untouched.

On the "live" mechanism I recommend **polling with `ETag`, not SSE**: leads arrive in minutes, so a 30–60s interval reads as live to a human and `304 Not Modified` makes it nearly free, whereas SSE needs the BE to fan events out from every lead writer for a difference nobody sees on that screen. - **The scoreboard itself** — blocked on leads data that does not exist in any of the three services.
- **Live updating** — blocked on the same, plus a transport decision that needs BE work.

I touched no source files; the only change is the untracked doc. Nothing committed, nothing pushed, no server started. I ran no typecheck or test suite because no source changed — there was nothing to verify beyond the citations, which I checked individually.

The fastest unblock is question 2: tell me what counts as a lead for these brands, and I'll take it from there.

+	"context"
+	"errors"

+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/kitapos/kitapos/internal/repository"
+)

+// GiftCard is the slice of a gift card Redeem has to judge. It lives here
+// rather than in domain because the table, the repository and the handler land
+// later; move it to domain in the change that adds them.
+type GiftCard struct {
+	Code string
+	// Balance is the remaining value in whole rupiah.
+	Balance   int64
+	ExpiresAt *time.Time
+	IsActive  bool
+}
+
+// expired reads an absent ExpiresAt as "never expires", and treats the instant
+// itself as past: a card good "until 2026-11-01" cannot be spent at midnight on
+// the first.
+func (c GiftCard) expired(now time.Time) bool {
+	return c.ExpiresAt != nil && !now.Before(*c.ExpiresAt)
+}
+
+type GiftCardRepository interface {
+	// GetByCode returns repository.ErrNotFound when no card carries the code.
+	GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*GiftCard, error)
+	// Debit subtracts amount and returns the remaining balance, applying the
+	// write ONLY while the stored row still satisfies balance >= amount and the
+	// card is active and unexpired. The guard belongs inside the statement, not
+	// only in the service: two terminals redeeming one card both read the same
+	// balance before either writes. It returns repository.ErrConflict when no
+	// row matched, which is the lost race.
+	Debit(ctx context.Context, code string, amount int64) (remaining int64, err error)
+}
+
+var (
+	ErrGiftCardCodeRequired  = errors.New("kode kartu hadiah wajib diisi")
+	ErrGiftCardAmountInvalid = errors.New("nominal penukaran harus lebih dari nol")
+	ErrGiftCardNotFound      = errors.New("kartu hadiah tidak ditemukan")
+	ErrGiftCardInactive      = errors.New("kartu hadiah sudah tidak aktif")
+	ErrGiftCardExpired       = errors.New("kartu hadiah sudah kedaluwarsa")
+	ErrGiftCardInsufficient  = errors.New("saldo kartu hadiah tidak cukup")
+)
+
+type GiftCardService struct {
+	repo GiftCardRepository
+	// now is injected so the expiry branch is testable without waiting for a
+	// clock.
+	now func() time.Time
+}
+
+func NewGiftCardService(repo GiftCardRepository) *GiftCardService {
+	return &GiftCardService{repo: repo, now: time.Now}
+}
+
+// Redeem spends amount off the card, refusing an expired card and a balance
+// that cannot cover it. The read decides the refusal so the caller gets a
+// sentence naming which rule it broke; the conditional Debit decides the write,
+// so a card redeemed twice at once cannot go negative.
+func (s *GiftCardService) Redeem(ctx context.Context, code string, amount int64) error {
+	code = strings.TrimSpace(code)
+	if code == "" {
+		return ErrGiftCardCodeRequired
+	}
+	if amount <= 0 {
+		return ErrGiftCardAmountInvalid
+	}
+
+	card, err := s.repo.GetByCode(ctx, code)
+	if errors.Is(err, repository.ErrNotFound) {
+		return ErrGiftCardNotFound
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if card == nil {
+		return ErrGiftCardNotFound
+	}
+	if !card.IsActive {
+		return ErrGiftCardInactive
+	}

+		return ErrGiftCardExpired
+	}

+		return ErrGiftCardInsufficient
+	}

+		// someone else spent the card first. Report it as the balance refusal
+		// rather than a 500: that is what is true by the time the cashier reads
+		// it.
+		if errors.Is(err, repository.ErrConflict) {
+			return ErrGiftCardInsufficient
+		}
+		return err
+	}

`src/lib/ui/affiliate/RingkasanPeriode.svelte`, placed under the KPI tiles. It shows average GMV per month, strongest month, weakest month, GMV per 1,000 views, and a badge for last month vs. the month before. The maths sits in a pure module, `src/lib/affiliate/ringkasan-periode.ts`.

cases.reply:
Tidak saya kerjakan — dan ini bukan soal effort, tiga hal memblokirnya dan semuanya saya cek dulu di repo.

## 1. Data "leads" tidak ada sama sekali

Saya sapu seluruh FE dan seluruh daftar endpoint BE yang dikenal FE (`src/lib/api/`, `postman/`). Nol kecocokan untuk konsep lead — satu-satunya hit `lead` di codebase adalah utility Tailwind `leading-*`. Permukaan BE lengkapnya (~80 rute) isinya revenue, okr, finance, cx, ecom-crm, partners, spend, product, sku-funnel, admin. Tidak ada `/leads`, tidak ada kolom lead, tidak ada tabel lead.

`AGENTS.md` bahkan mencatat yang lebih dasar belum ada: **"Jumlah pesanan tidak ada di tabel mana pun — ini satu-satunya yang butuh migrasi baru."** Kalau jumlah *pesanan* saja belum ada, jumlah *lead* jauh di belakang itu.

Jadi scoreboard lead hari ini hanya bisa diisi angka karangan. Itu persis yang dilarang aturan produk repo ini: *"Lubang data ditandai, tidak dikarang. Jangan mengisi dengan nol yang terbaca seperti 'tidak ada penjualan'."*

## 2. Tidak ada kanal push yang mungkin di arsitektur ini

- `vite.config.ts` → `adapter-static`, `src/routes/+layout.ts` → `prerender = true`. Build-nya HTML statis murni, langsung ke `httpdocs` Plesk. **Tidak ada runtime Node di produksi**, jadi tidak ada tempat SSE atau WebSocket bisa hidup.
- Satu-satunya proses Node di prod adalah `tools/proksi-ai.mjs`, dan itu sengaja hanya boleh mengklaim `/api/ai`, `/api/sesi`, `/api/pengaturan` — dulu ia mengklaim seluruh `/api/` dan menelan `/api/v1/*`. Menempelkan kanal lead di situ mengulang bug itu.

"Update tiap ada lead baru masuk" menuntut server yang bisa memegang koneksi. Repo ini tidak punya, by design.

## 3. Lu sendiri sudah memutuskan ini kemarin

Keputusan 2026-10-07, terekam: *"jangan deh biasa aja pakai api biasa, nggk usah pakai live live gitu"* — setelah ditunjukkan bahwa sumber datanya cuma berubah per refresh MV (~8 menit, affiliate) atau harian (revenue). Streaming tidak bisa membuat angka lebih segar daripada sumbernya; yang bikin kerasa lambat itu query berat (partners/attribution 6s, ecom-crm/insight 3-4s), bukan transport-nya.

Kalau keputusan itu sudah berubah, bilang saja — tapi saya tidak mau membalikkannya diam-diam.

## Jalannya kalau memang mau

Urutannya BE dulu, dan tak ada satu pun langkah yang bisa dikerjakan di repo FE ini:

1. **Tentukan apa itu "lead" di Hegemoni** — chat WA masuk? form? DM? Belum ada definisinya di sistem mana pun.
2. **Migrasi + ingestion di `module-cco-command-center-service-be`** — tabel lead beserta timestamp-nya, plus sumber yang mengisinya.
3. **Endpoint `/leads/scoreboard`** mengikuti pola provenance yang sudah ada (`live`/`estimated`/`unavailable`).
4. **Baru** adapter + blok di `HalamanCeo.svelte`. Dan di tahap itu pun transportnya tetap request/response: refetch berinterval sesuai kecepatan sumbernya, bukan push.

Yang sudah ada sekarang dan menjawab 80% kebutuhan "CEO nggak perlu refresh": tombol **Segarkan** di `src/routes/HalamanCeo.svelte:313` (`segarkan()`) — satu klik, tanpa reload halaman. Kalau mau, yang bisa saya kerjakan tanpa BE adalah membuat itu otomatis per interval di layar CEO, dengan label "diperbarui HH:MM" supaya CEO tahu angkanya umur berapa. Itu jujur, kecil, dan tidak melawan keputusan kemarin — tapi tetap bukan "scoreboard leads", karena datanya belum lahir.

**Tidak ada berkas yang saya ubah.** `git status` bersih.
